DISTINCT_DISEASE.interpretation: TRD has reproducible clinical/treatment-course features, but no robust pretreatment categorical boundary or stable intrinsic causal/pathological discriminator defines TRD as one disease.

BIOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE_OR_ENDOTYPE.interpretation: Multiple candidate biological endotypes are plausible and some may moderate treatment, but the whole TRD category is not one reproducible endotype; endotypes likely cut across the TRD boundary.

DIMENSION_OR_SPECTRUM.interpretation: Resistance behaves substantially as a graded treatment-course/severity/chronicity construct; operational cut-points are useful but no natural discontinuity is established.

DISEASE_STAGE.interpretation: Successive nonresponse has longitudinal ordering and poorer prognosis, supporting a stage-like component, but not every TRD case reflects biological progression rather than baseline endotype or contextual/pseudo-resistance.

TREATMENT_RESPONSE_STATE.interpretation: TRD is strongly supported as a treatment-response state, provided adequacy and pseudoresistance are assessed. Objective resistance biology is not yet generalizable.

OPERATIONAL_CLINICAL_CATEGORY.interpretation: TRD is strongly supported as an operational clinical/regulatory/service category with clear treatment and burden implications.

DISTINCT_DISEASE.interpretation: Higher-confidence evidence does not support TRD as one distinct disease; biological findings remain quantitative, overlapping, heterogeneous, or post-resistance.

BIOLOGICAL_SUBTYPE_OR_ENDOTYPE.interpretation: Biological endotypes are supported as a research direction and likely exist within depression, but no validated endotype maps cleanly onto global TRD membership.

DIMENSION_OR_SPECTRUM.interpretation: A graded resistance/severity/chronicity axis is well supported; the two-failure threshold is operational rather than a demonstrated natural discontinuity.

DISEASE_STAGE.interpretation: A stage-like component is supported, especially accumulated treatment failure and chronicity, but stage is not sufficient as a universal explanation.

TREATMENT_RESPONSE_STATE.interpretation: The strongest ontologically modest description is a treatment-response state; rigor depends on treatment adequacy, adherence and exclusion of pseudoresistance.

OPERATIONAL_CLINICAL_CATEGORY.interpretation: The operational category is strongly supported and has demonstrated clinical, treatment, regulatory and resource-allocation utility.
